summary: Non-Invasive Monitoring Systems (NIMS) filed an 8-K disclosing Amendment No. 2 to its merger agreement with Gravitics, Inc., dated August 11, 2026. The amendment modifies post-merger ownership so Gravitics stockholders will own ~96.5% of the combined company and NIMS stockholders ~3.5% (from previous terms). This reverse merger structure has Gravitics Merger Sub merging into Gravitics, with Gravitics as surviving subsidiary of NIMS. No price per share, premium, or advisors were disclosed. The deal is effectively an acquisition of NIMS by Gravitics' shareholders via stock issuance. Watch for shareholder approvals and closing conditions; risk-arb centers on regulatory and timing uncertainty.
